gate_gaps: No frozen unseen holdout partition exists; current evidence is calibration or regression only.
Card evidence does not establish >=99.5% held-out whole-card accuracy across all ranks, suits, lighting, and overlays.
Numeric evidence does not establish >=99.0% held-out exact accuracy for stacks, bets, pots, and side pots.
Seat/action evidence does not establish held-out coverage for every seat, dealer location, player state, timer, active-player marker, and sizing control.
Recorded exact-layout replay p95 remains above the 200 ms decision-window budget.
Showdown cards and side pots lack sufficient labeled evidence.
limitations: Coverage is inferred only from structured privacy-safe records and file metadata; it is not ground truth.
Raw OCR text and player identity are intentionally excluded.
Observed coverage cannot satisfy a promotion gate without independently labeled holdout cases.
